purpose: Bounds the dependencies, parent, and build plugins that generated build configuration may declare. Enforced against the scaffolded POM before it is persisted (FR-017). Every entry must be resolvable from a pre-populated local Maven repository, because the hermetic offline build runs with network access disabled (Constitution IV).
deliberately_outside_instructions_dir: This file lives in backend/app/resources/, NOT inside backend/app/resources/instructions/. It is a generation constraint, not an instruction document, and is excluded from the instruction-set revision digest so that editing the allowlist does not change the revision recorded against generated artifacts. See specs/011-llm-generation-nodes/contracts/instruction-document.md.
seeded_from: The dependency set of the known-good POM template emitted by the pre-migration scaffolder stage, which is verified to resolve in the shipped offline build environment.

parent.note: Dependency versions are managed by the parent. Individual dependencies must not pin their own versions unless listed below.

dependencies.why: HTTP surface for the generated controllers.
Persistence and repository support for generated entities.
Jakarta Validation support for declaratively constrained request contracts.
In-memory datasource so a freshly generated project runs and tests without provisioning.
Durable relational driver for the inferred production datasource (high/medium volume). NOTE: the hermetic offline build still runs against H2 until this artifact is present in the local Maven cache.
JUnit 5, Mockito, and AssertJ, which the test instruction mandates.
Versioned native database migrations / selected database driver; prepare dependencies explicitly before offline verification.
Versioned native database migrations / selected database driver; prepare dependencies explicitly before offline verification.

build_plugins.why: Pins the Java 21 release level deterministically.

prohibited: Any groupId/artifactId pair not present in the dependencies list above.
Any build plugin not present in the build_plugins list above.
Version ranges, SNAPSHOT versions, and the LATEST or RELEASE selectors.
Any additional <repositories>, <pluginRepositories>, or remote repository declaration.
Any dependency with a javax.* groupId or artifactId.
Any build extension, remote script execution, or artifact downloaded at build time.
Any dependency, plugin, or property carrying a credential or access token.

enforcement.on_violation: Reject the candidate artifact set; the POM must not be persisted with an unlisted declaration. Failure to enforce this is absorbed silently by the verification environment's offline-cache fallback, so it must be caught before persistence, not after the build.
